calls.sql: SELECT d.ordered_on, c.name, c.id AS customer_id, o.id AS order_id, o.item, o.total_eur FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT o2.ordered_on FROM orders o2 JOIN customers c2 ON c2.id=o2.customer_id WHERE c2.name='Dora Novak') d ON d.ordered_on=o.ordered_on WHERE c.name<>'Dora Novak' ORDER BY d.ordered_on, c.name
SELECT c.id, c.name, o.id, o.ordered_on FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.name LIKE '%Dora%' OR c.name LIKE '%Novak%'
